# API reference

LostFinder 1.0.0. Every branch serves the same API: Campus `http://localhost:8001`, Bus Park `http://localhost:8002`, Airport `http://localhost:8003`. Interactive version with a *Try it out* button: `/docs` on any branch.

Sign in with `POST /auth/login` (form fields `username` = email, `password`) and send the token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. A token works at every branch.

*This file is generated by `scripts/make_api_docs.py`.*

## Auth

| Method | Path | Who | What | Body |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/auth/login` | anyone | Log in with email (as 'username') and password. Returns a JWT token. | form fields |
| GET | `/auth/me` | signed in | Your own account (checks that your token is still valid). |  |
| PATCH | `/auth/me` | signed in | Change your own name or phone number. | ProfileUpdate |
| POST | `/auth/me/password` | signed in | Change your own password (you must give the current one). | PasswordChange |
| POST | `/auth/register` | anyone | Public sign-up. Every new account has the role 'user' and can report both LOST and FOUND items. | RegisterIn |
| POST | `/users` | admin | Admin creates any account, e.g. staff for a branch. | CreateUserIn |

## Users (admin)

| Method | Path | Who | What | Body |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/users` | admin | Every account, with how many reports and claims each person made. Filter by text, role or status. |  |
| GET | `/users/{user_id}` | admin | One account, with its report and claim counts. |  |
| PATCH | `/users/{user_id}` | admin | Change someone's name, phone, role, branch (staff) or disable/enable the account. | UserAdminUpdate |
| POST | `/users/{user_id}/password` | admin | Set a new password for someone who forgot theirs. Give it to them in person. | PasswordReset |

## Items

| Method | Path | Who | What | Body |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/items` | anyone | Search items. Public: no login needed, so owners can look before signing up. |  |
| POST | `/items` | signed in | Report a LOST or FOUND item. Any logged-in user can report either type. | ItemIn |
| GET | `/items/mine` | signed in | Items reported by the logged-in user, at any branch (copies are on every branch). |  |
| DELETE | `/items/{item_id}` | admin | Delete an item (admin only, at its home branch). The other branches delete their copies. |  |
| GET | `/items/{item_id}` | anyone | One item (this branch's copy). Public. |  |
| PATCH | `/items/{item_id}` | signed in | Edit an item. Allowed for: the person who reported it, staff of its home branch, or an admin. | ItemUpdate |
| GET | `/items/{item_id}/matches` | anyone | Possible matches for an item: LOST items get FOUND candidates and the other way round. |  |
| POST | `/items/{item_id}/photo` | signed in | Attach a photo to an item (at its home branch). | file upload |

## Photos

| Method | Path | Who | What | Body |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/photos/{photo_hash}` | anyone | Get Photo |  |

## Claims

| Method | Path | Who | What | Body |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/claims` | staff, admin | Staff: claims on their branch's items. Admin: all claims. |  |
| GET | `/claims/mine` | signed in | Your claims, at any branch, newest first. |  |
| GET | `/claims/queued/mine` | signed in | Claims you made at THIS branch that are waiting for (or were sent to) an offline home branch. |  |
| POST | `/claims/{claim_id}/approve` | staff, admin | Staff checked the answer and are convinced: the owner may collect the item. |  |
| POST | `/claims/{claim_id}/handover` | staff, admin | The owner collected the item: the case is closed (item RETURNED). |  |
| POST | `/claims/{claim_id}/reject` | staff, admin | Staff are not convinced. The item becomes claimable again. |  |
| GET | `/items/{item_id}/claims` | signed in | Claims on one item: visible to staff of its home branch, admins, and the person who found it. |  |
| POST | `/items/{item_id}/claims` | signed in | Claim a FOUND item as yours. Only one claim per item can be active at a time. | ClaimIn |

## Stats

| Method | Path | Who | What | Body |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/me/matches` | signed in | Possible matches for every item the user reported, with the reasons behind each score. |  |
| GET | `/me/overview` | signed in | The logged-in user's own figures. |  |
| GET | `/stats/overview` | anyone | Network-wide figures: reports per day, by category, status and branch; claims; return rate. |  |

## Branches

| Method | Path | Who | What | Body |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/branches` | anyone | The three branch offices. |  |

## Health

| Method | Path | Who | What | Body |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/health` | anyone | Is this branch up? Also checks its database and says where photos are stored. |  |

## Replication

| Method | Path | Who | What | Body |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/cluster` | anyone | This branch's view of the other branches, from its heartbeat monitor (up / down / unknown). |  |
| POST | `/replication/resync` | admin | Admin: compare data with every other branch now and repair anything missing or older. |  |
| GET | `/replication/snapshot` | branches only | Everything this branch holds (users, items, claims). Only other branches may call it. |  |
| GET | `/replication/status` | anyone | RabbitMQ connection state, events sent/received, unsent events waiting in the outbox, |  |

## Notifications

| Method | Path | Who | What | Body |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/me/activity` | signed in | Recent matches and claims that concern you, newest first. |  |

## WebSocket

| Path | Who | What |
|---|---|---|
| `ws://<branch>/ws?token=<token>` | signed in | Live notifications: matches and claim decisions |
